_help: Единственный источник правды для сайта. После правки запустите: python3 tools/build.py. Поля со значением null показываются на сайте как «скоро». Подробности в README.md.

schedule._help: next_meeting: дата ближайшей встречи в формате ГГГГ-ММ-ДД, например "2026-12-01". time: время в 24-часовом формате, например "19:00". regular: как часто встречаемся. room: где именно в здании.

contact._help: Контакт для записи. Только то, что уже опубликовано на сайте прихода или что прямо дал о. Андрей. Личные телефоны участников сюда не пишем.

ui.site_title: Bodbe Brothers — a men's singing club in Orlando
ui.meta_description: A men's singing club in Orlando. Old songs and good company. No experience needed, free.

hero.title: Bodbe Brothers
hero.lead: Old songs and good company, twice a month in Orlando. No experience needed. Just come.
hero.image_alt: Illustration: men singing together at a long candlelit table under a grapevine at sunset

about.title: Men who like to sing
about.body: Bodbe Brothers is a bunch of men who get together to sing old songs. That's the whole plan.
about.closer: If you've ever sung “Happy Birthday” at a party, you'll be fine. If you haven't, come anyway and sit next to someone loud.
about.image_alt: Illustration: men of different ages singing from sheets in a stone hall, an older man conducting

steps.label: Gather
steps.text: Walk in and say hello. Nobody expects you to know anyone. Someone will be waving at you.

steps.label: Sing
steps.text: A short warm-up, then we work on a song together. By the end of the evening you'll know a verse, maybe two.

bodbe.title: Say it: BOD-beh
paras: Bodbe is a village in Kakheti, a region of eastern Georgia. Georgia the country, that is, not the state, though we hear Savannah is lovely.
Kakheti is known for men who sing together in harmony late into the evening.
That's the kind of evening we're after. Hence the name.
bodbe.image_alt: Illustration: vineyard hills of Kakheti at dusk

songs.title: The first songs
songs.intro: Mostly the sacred music of the Orthodox peoples: Orthodox liturgical chant, and the hymns and carols that grew up around it in Russia, Ukraine, Georgia and beyond. Old music, made to be sung together.

items.title: Many Years
items.text: A short Orthodox hymn of good wishes, sung for birthdays, name days and guests of honour. A handful of words; you'll be singing it by the second round.

items.title: Shen Khar Venakhi
items.text: A medieval Georgian hymn to the Mother of God. The title means “You are a vineyard.” Slow, in three voices, and once you've heard it you won't forget it.

items.title: Christmas carols
items.text: Carols from the different homelands of the men who sing with us. Learned in the autumn, sung in December, see below.

items.title: Carols for people who can't get out
items.text: We'll take the carols to people in our community who are sick or elderly and can't get out much. A few songs at the door, a few minutes of company.

items.a: Most of us can't, officially. Come anyway: the point is singing together, not singing well. If you can hum along to the radio, you're in.

items.q: We meet at a church. Do I have to be religious?
items.a: No. This is a singing club, not a service. Much of what we sing is church music, but nobody will quiz you on anything. Come as you are.
We talk in English. We sing in English, Church Slavonic, Georgian and other languages, and take the words slowly so nobody gets lost.
Just yourself. And maybe a friend.

ways.title: Just come
ways.text: No sign-up, no list, no fee. Just walk in.

ways.title: Call first, if you'd rather
ways.text: Call the office and ask about Bodbe Brothers. We'll get back to you.

footer.note: Bodbe Brothers is a men's singing club that meets at Saint Nina Orthodox Church, Orlando.
footer.images_note: Photographs on this page are illustrations, not pictures of our members.
